subject.title: feat(agents): Swarm core — collector spawn, agents_wait, structured output, caps (gated)

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this initial core Swarm contract—`tools.swarm`, collector extensions to `sessions_spawn`, `agents_wait`, and durable collector records—as the approved v1 direction?
rationale: This is a new core agent-orchestration API with persistent-state and gateway implications; patch correctness alone cannot determine whether this is the desired permanent product boundary.

options.title: Sponsor the gated core v1
options.body: Keep the PR open and require explicit owner sign-off plus fresh-install, upgrade, restart, and real-behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow or defer the core contract
options.body: Retain the broader Swarm discussion but split or redirect parts that should not become a permanent core config and protocol surface yet.

recommendation.body: Keep the PR open and require explicit owner sign-off plus fresh-install, upgrade, restart, and real-behavior proof before merge.
